messages:
Alice (eng-runtime): quick heads-up — ran a small perf sweep on mixed SM farm. noticed a throughput regression on sm86 after the driver bump; looks like our kernel selection prefers the fp8-tc path even for seqlen 32-64 workloads
Ben (perf): details? numbers?
Alice (eng-runtime): baseline (old driver) on sm86 gpus: ~2800 toks/s for seqlen=64, batch=8. new driver: ~2100 toks/s. p50 latency +45%
Carol (ml-infra): did you capture the profiler? nvprof/nsys traces?
Alice (eng-runtime): attached snippet from nsys (trimmed):
```
matmul_kernel: selected=matmul_tc_fp8_k, time=2.8ms
matmul_kernel: alt=matmul_bf16_k, time=1.6ms
kv_cache_lookup: hitrate=0.12, avg_latency=0.3ms
```
Ben (perf): whoa picked tc fp8 but slower than bf16? suggests driver-tuned tensor core path has regression for small M/N dims
Dmitri (hw-eng): we saw a driver change that reorders TC MMA schedules. on sm86 it sometimes pays off only for larger GEMM sizes. small seqlens (<=64) are probably in the wrong regime
Alice (eng-runtime): current autotune heuristic: pick tensorcore path if device reports fp8 + tensorcore support and seqlen >= 32. we probably need to raise threshold and add a fallback probe on first N runs
Carol (ml-infra): propose: 1) runtime probe: microbench two matmul variants on first request (cheap sample) 2) hysteresis: require consistent wins for k probes before switching 3) per-device driver-version override table
Ben (perf): microprobe idea good — keep it async and cached in per-device metadata. also record sample metrics to console for rollbacks
perf-bot: perf-trace recorded: job=autotune-sample, device=sm86-02, driver=537.21, matmul_tc_fp8_k=2.85ms, matmul_bf16_k=1.64ms, sample_runs=8
Dmitri (hw-eng): I'll confirm driver changelog and see if NV has patched a schedule. but we should not depend on vendor fix alone
Alice (eng-runtime): implementation notes: add probe in device-init path, but gate on traffic (skip for cold nodes with <100 tokens/s to avoid noise). store decision as device.cap_flags.autotune_choice and TTL=24h. update kernel routing priority: explicit per-device override then seqlen heuristic then capability flags
Ben (perf): also update batching heuristic: for paths where tc wins only at large M, prefer splitting large requests into two smaller batches? hmm that could harm latency. maybe suggest adaptive batch-splitting in background for throughput jobs
Carol (ml-infra): I'll wire the metrics: token/s, p50, kernel_choice, driver_ver to the per-route dashboard. also add an alert when choice flips >3 times in 1h
Alice (eng-runtime): action items: Dmitri checks driver, Ben adds microprobe + hysteresis PR, Carol adds dashboard and alert, I'll add fallback override TTL logic. tagging @here for visibility :eyes:
Ben (perf): I'll open a draft PR with perf numbers and a simple microprobe harness (shell command and nsys run)
Dmitri (hw-eng): FYI nv support asked for sample traces; I'll send them once we collect a small bundle
Alice (eng-runtime): thanks. let's aim to have a canary rollout on staging by EOD tomorrow.
